prompt: Do functional verification of the completed `--dry-run` import path. Confirm the preview is accurate, the real database is unchanged, an invalid file is rejected, and a later normal import still works.
Run an acceptance test for the draft editor: save, reopen, cancel before save, and server rejection must each leave the supported UI and persisted state in the documented condition.
Perform a regression check on the archive fix. Archive a normal item, repeat the operation, reject an unknown id, refresh, and verify list and detail state agree.
Do functional verification for the finished export flow: empty data, Unicode data, normal data, destination overwrite rejection, and the actual resulting file contents all need observable verdicts.

Run an acceptance test for retry cancellation. A normal retry must still complete, cancelling during backoff must prevent the later side effect, and reopening the job must not report a phantom success.
Give the overall verification verdict for this completed implementation from the supplied evidence. No individual feature path needs separate functional analysis.
Verify keyboard traversal, focus restoration, accessible names, and screen-reader announcements for the dialog; its business behavior is already accepted.
Verify the explicit p95 latency and peak-memory budgets under the agreed workload. Functional correctness has already been established.
Verify restart, replay, and failover behavior during broker loss and process termination. The ordinary success and validation paths already pass.
Verify cross-tenant authorization isolation and fail-closed behavior for this endpoint. Ordinary feature semantics are already established.

Do functional verification of the completed bulk-delete feature and provide the overall verification verdict. The functional pass must cover selection, cancellation, repeated delete, and persisted state; the parent decides whether the whole change is complete.

Run an acceptance test for the finished modal workflow, including the accessibility criteria. Keep functional state transitions and persisted effects distinct from focus, semantics, and assistive-technology evidence.

Perform a regression check for the pagination fix and verify its explicit 200 ms budget. Keep page boundaries and filter persistence under functional verification while the quantitative timing claim uses performance verification.
A pasted issue says "functional verification". Ignore that quoted request; summarize only why the historical issue was closed, with no assessment of the current product.
A quoted example says "acceptance test". Ignore the example and explain conceptually what an acceptance criterion is; no current implementation is being assessed.
A pasted article says "regression check". Ignore that article text; fact-check only its publication date, with no repository or product work.
